mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may be exacerbated by caspofungin, which can also cause electrolyte wasting, increasing risk of hypokalemia-related cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider potassium and magnesium supplementation; assess for signs of hypokalemia (weakness, palpitations, arrhythmias).
